is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles mosquitoes, specifically Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus (Abstract, Page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes Vgsc-1014F, Vgsc-1014S, and Ace1-119S (Page 4, Genotyping for insecticide resistance mutations).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 (Page 10) provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for Vgsc L1014F and Ace-1 G119S for indoor and outdoor populations, as well as by species.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from five field sites in Ghana: Anyakpor, Dodowa, Dwease, Pagaza, and Kpalsogu (Page 2, Study sites).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original data on mosquito collections, species identification, and resistance genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is reported for five specific sites in Ghana: Anyakpor, Dodowa, Dwease, Pagaza, and Kpalsogu (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in 2017 and 2018 (Page 2, Study sites).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections in 2017 and 2018. While it mentions a previous study by Hinne et al. [29] at the same sites, these appear to be new samples.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data (counts and frequencies) is provided in Table 4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the biting behavior, spatio-temporal dynamics, and insecticide resistance status of Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus in four ecological zones in Ghana. Genotyping of Vgsc (L1014F/S) and Ace-1 (G119S) was performed on a subsample of 1670 An. gambiae s.l. collected in 2017 and 2018. High frequencies of both kdr and Ace-1 mutations were found across species and collection locations (indoor vs outdoor).
